nodes.label: Phase Status Read-Only Constraint
nodes.rationale: Status subcommand is read-only — no writes to phase_status.md or plan/ACTIVE allowed during status queries, enforcing separation between observation and mutation.

nodes.label: Tripwire Halt Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Tripwire halt blocks all forward phase progress and must be surfaced explicitly. Two resolution paths: approve narrow edit with GH issue record, or re-triage via --remode. Prevents silent scope expansion.

nodes.label: Phase Mode-Legal Entry Guard
nodes.rationale: Mode governs which phases are accessible. direct-edit chain is ide→ral→qa; aln is not part of it. Entry guard rejects attempts to enter phases not in the WI mode chain.

nodes.label: Phase Exit Artifact Guard
nodes.rationale: Exiting ide phase requires idea.md to exist. If artifact absent, exit is rejected and missing artifact named explicitly. Ensures phase completion has concrete deliverables.

nodes.label: next_phase Computed at Read Time
nodes.rationale: next_phase is not a stored field but computed from mode+current_phase+flags at read time. needs_research=true triggers res phase next. Avoids stale stored state.

nodes.label: Four-Axis Triage Model
nodes.rationale: Triage scores four axes: design ambiguity, blast radius, reversibility, existing test coverage. All-low → direct-edit. Any medium → mini. Any high or tripwire → full. HITL confirmation required before mode is locked.

nodes.label: HITL Mode Confirmation Requirement
nodes.rationale: Agent must present axis scores and proposed mode to human for confirmation. Mode cannot be auto-picked. Ensures human accountability for the work item scope decision.

nodes.label: Remode Re-triage Mechanism
nodes.rationale: --remode flag triggers re-triage of an existing WI mid-phase when tripwire discovery expands scope beyond current mode (e.g., mini→full). Preserves audit trail and requires human decision.

nodes.label: B10 Codebase Exploration Budget
nodes.rationale: Triage exploration limited to 5 file reads (B10 dispatch). Budget exceeded on 6th read. Constrains agent exploration cost during triage before mode is confirmed.
